description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates property animations using ObjectAnimator, AnimatorSet, and related classes. It sets up various animated buttons and handles user interactions to trigger animations, either from code or loaded from XML resources.

classes.name: PropertyAnimations
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating property animations with buttons and checkboxes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up buttons, and configures animations.

methods.name: setupAnimation
methods.description: Configures click listeners for views to start animations, either from code or XML resources.
